requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE premium 2D PIXEL ART environment concept sheet: Bamboo Forest / Rung Truc dungeon for Vo Lam Hero Defense. CONCEPT ONLY, not production map or tileset. Landscape 1536x1024 or larger. Reference image 1 arena-v2-approved is the PRIMARY art style: lush detailed clustered pixel foliage, stepped crisp outlines, jade/emerald greens with bamboo-yellow highlights, weathered warm gray stone, small warm lantern accents, elevated orthographic three-quarter RPG camera. Reference images 2-4 creep master sheets and image 5 actual Cái Bang idle sprite are SCALE ONLY; do not redraw or invent characters or enemies. Generate NO creatures, enemies, or heroes in this sheet. Original ancient Chinese bamboo forest, richly authored, never realistic 3D, never isometric diamond grid. Camera locked north-up, square axis-aligned ground, no vanishing point, vertical bamboo trunks and visible prop fronts as in arena. Full dungeon overview, no HUD. A compact rectangular continuous outdoor map inspired by existing 30x20 tiles at32px =960x640 logical footprint; presentation enlarged uniformly, not a distant miniature world. Broad western entry clearing and physical blue-jade stone exit portal immediately west of it, broad central mossy cracked martial training court, broad eastern earth-and-stone combat clearing, connected with wide curving natural paths and at least two generous approaches. Main clearings have generous empty low-detail warm earth/paving for six players; design routes at least four terrain tiles wide, no single-file corridors, no locked room gates, no stairs changing gameplay elevation. Spawn locations are empty visually recognizable perimeter openings along east clearing, not magical spawners. Dense tall bamboo groves and moss rocks frame edges, rich grass, leaf scatter, ancient low ruined Chinese walls and small shrine along northern border, lanterns outside fighting centers, wooden training dummies at training-court edge, bamboo fences with large openings. A small shallow turquoise stream hugs southern perimeter, with TWO small but broad wood bridges on optional outer paths; stream must not split mandatory fighting space. Foreground bamboo leaf canopy only along lower outer corners, keeping feet/routes visible. Subtle sunlight filtered through bamboo, dappled pixel highlights with NO blurred cinematic godrays. Emerald, jade, moss, bamboo yellow, natural brown, weathered stone gray. Restrained pink/cream flowers only at borders; less floral than Main Arena. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters consistent throughout, no procedural rectangle look or smeared texture. Main scene fills almost entire sheet. Small tasteful ivory title strip at top 'BAMBOO FOREST - DUNGEON OVERVIEW' and small footer 'CONCEPT ONLY - 32px TERRAIN REFERENCE - NO GAMEPLAY CHANGES'. No annotations over combat floor, no new enemy designs.
